name: etzba
description: אצבע — shift tracker and pay calculator for hourly workers in Israel. An Edvin Studios Project.
author: Ilan Levy (Ilanox)

scripts.start:www: npm run build && node scripts/serve.mjs www
scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && node scripts/native-setup.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android: npm run build && node scripts/native-setup.mjs && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run build && node scripts/native-setup.mjs && npx cap run android
